facts.fact: The University of Malawi states that its Computing Department, through HISP UNIMA, supports the Ministry of Health and Sanitation in implementing the national Health Management Information System and DHIS2 systems; no event date is given, so the document's published date (itself a proxy from the URL) is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Sanitation; developed by the University of Malawi Computing Department (HISP UNIMA) with the ministry and partners
systems.tiers: community level: Health Surveillance Assistants in 15 districts, 3,764 HSAs and Senior HSAs trained and using it

note: The document describes only iCHIS, a community health worker system, in any detail. The national HMIS is classed hmis on its being called the national health management information system, with no description of what it reports; MaHIS and 'DHIS2 systems' are named with no description and left unclassified.
